verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἡ ἀληθινή ἄμπελος καὶ ὁ μου Πατήρ ἐστιν ὁ γεωργός
verses.transliteration: Egō eimi hē hē alēthinē ampelos kai ho mou Patēr estin ho geōrgos
verses.literal: I am the - true vine and - My Father is the keeper of the vineyard

verses.original: αἴρει αὐτό πᾶν κλῆμα ἐν ἐμοὶ μὴ φέρον καρπὸν καὶ πᾶν τὸ φέρον καρπὸν καθαίρει αὐτὸ ἵνα φέρῃ πλείονα καρπὸν
verses.transliteration: airei auto pan klēma en emoi mē pheron karpon kai pan to pheron karpon kathairei auto hina pherē pleiona karpon
verses.literal: He cuts off . . . every branch in Me vvv that bears no fruit and every [branch] that does bear fruit He prunes - to make it even more fruitful . . . . . .

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἤδη καθαροί διὰ τὸν λόγον ὃν λελάληκα ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: hymeis este ēdē katharoi dia ton logon hon lelalēka hymin
verses.literal: You are already clean because of the word - I have spoken to you

verses.original: μείνατε ἐν ἐμοί κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν καθὼς τὸ οὐ κλῆμα δύναται φέρειν ἀφ’ καρπὸν ἑαυτοῦ ἐὰν μὴ μένῃ ἐν τῇ ἀμπέλῳ οὕτως οὐδὲ ὑμεῖς ἐὰν μὴ μένητε ἐν ἐμοὶ
verses.transliteration: meinate en emoi kagō en hymin kathōs to ou klēma dynatai pherein aph’ karpon heautou ean mē menē en tē ampelō houtōs oude hymeis ean mē menēte en emoi
verses.literal: Remain in Me and I {will remain} in you Just as - no branch can bear vvv fruit by itself unless . . . it remains in the vine - neither [can] you [bear fruit] unless . . . you remain in Me

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἄμπελος ὑμεῖς τὰ κλήματα ὁ μένων ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ οὗτος φέρει πολύν καρπὸν ὅτι χωρὶς ἐμοῦ οὐ δύνασθε ποιεῖν οὐδέν
verses.transliteration: Egō eimi hē ampelos hymeis ta klēmata ho menōn en emoi kagō en autō houtos pherei polyn karpon hoti chōris emou ou dynasthe poiein ouden
verses.literal: I am the vine [and] you [are] the branches The [one who] remains in Me and I in him - will bear much fruit For apart from Me vvv you can do nothing

verses.original: ἐὰν τις μή μένῃ ἐν ἐμοί ὡς τὸ κλῆμα ἐβλήθη ἔξω καὶ ἐξηράνθη καὶ αὐτὰ συνάγουσιν καὶ βάλλουσιν εἰς τὸ πῦρ καὶ καίεται
verses.transliteration: ean tis mē menē en emoi hōs to klēma eblēthē exō kai exēranthē kai auta synagousin kai ballousin eis to pyr kai kaietai
verses.literal: If anyone {does} not remain in Me {he is} like a branch that is thrown away and withers - [Such branches] are gathered up - thrown into the fire and burned

verses.original: ἐὰν μείνητε ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ τὰ μου ῥήματά μείνῃ ἐν ὑμῖν αἰτήσασθε ὃ ἐὰν θέλητε καὶ γενήσεται ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ean meinēte en emoi kai ta mou rhēmata meinē en hymin aitēsasthe ho ean thelēte kai genēsetai hymin
verses.literal: If you remain in Me and - My words remain in you ask whatever vvv you wish and it will be done for you

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ ὁ μου Πατήρ ἐδοξάσθη ἵνα φέρητε πολὺν καρπὸν καὶ γένησθε ἐμοὶ μαθηταί
verses.transliteration: en toutō ho mou Patēr edoxasthē hina pherēte polyn karpon kai genēsthe emoi mathētai
verses.literal: - This [is to] - My Father’s glory that you bear much fruit vvv [proving] yourselves to be My disciples

verses.original: Καθὼς ὁ Πατήρ ἠγάπησέν με κἀγὼ ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς μείνατε ἐν τῇ ἐμῇ τῇ ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: Kathōs ho Patēr ēgapēsen me kagō ēgapēsa hymas meinate en tē emē tē agapē
verses.literal: As the Father has loved Me so have I loved you Remain in - My - love

verses.original: ἐὰν τηρήσητε τὰς μου ἐντολάς μενεῖτε ἐν τῇ μου ἀγάπῃ καθὼς ἐγὼ τετήρηκα τοῦ μου Πατρός τὰς ἐντολὰς καὶ μένω ἐν τῇ αὐτοῦ ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: ean tērēsēte tas mou entolas meneite en tē mou agapē kathōs egō tetērēka tou mou Patros tas entolas kai menō en tē autou agapē
verses.literal: If you keep - My commandments you will remain in - My love just as I have kept - My Father’s - commandments and remain in - His love

verses.original: λελάληκα ὑμῖν Ταῦτα ἵνα ἡ ἐμὴ ἡ χαρὰ ᾖ ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ἡ ὑμῶν χαρὰ πληρωθῇ
verses.transliteration: lelalēka hymin Tauta hina hē emē hē chara ē en hymin kai hē hymōn chara plērōthē
verses.literal: I have told you these things so that - My - joy may be in you and - your joy may be complete

verses.original: Αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐμὴ ἡ ἐντολὴ ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους καθὼς ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Hautē estin hē emē hē entolē hina agapate allēlous kathōs ēgapēsa hymas
verses.literal: This is - My - commandment that you love one another as I have loved you

verses.original: μείζονα ἀγάπην ἔχει οὐδεὶς ταύτης ἵνα τις τὴν θῇ αὐτοῦ ψυχὴν ὑπὲρ τῶν αὐτοῦ φίλων
verses.transliteration: meizona agapēn echei oudeis tautēs hina tis tēn thē autou psychēn hyper tōn autou philōn
verses.literal: Greater love has no one than this that [he] - lay down his life for - his friends

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε μού φίλοι ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἃ ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Hymeis este mou philoi ean poiēte ha egō entellomai hymin
verses.literal: You are My friends if you do what I command you

verses.original: οὐκέτι λέγω ὑμᾶς δούλους ὅτι ὁ δοῦλος οὐκ οἶδεν τί αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος ποιεῖ δὲ εἴρηκα ὑμᾶς φίλους ὅτι πάντα ἃ ἤκουσα παρὰ μου Πατρός ἐγνώρισα τοῦ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ouketi legō hymas doulous hoti ho doulos ouk oiden ti autou ho kyrios poiei de eirēka hymas philous hoti panta ha ēkousa para mou Patros egnōrisa tou hymin
verses.literal: No longer do I call you servants for - a servant {does} not understand what his - master is doing But I have called you friends because everything - I have learned from My Father I have made known - to you

verses.original: ὑμεῖς οὐχ ἐξελέξασθε με ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔθηκα ὑμᾶς ἵνα ὑμεῖς ὑπάγητε καὶ φέρητε καρπὸν καὶ ὁ ὑμῶν καρπὸς μένῃ ἵνα ὅ¦τι ἂν αἰτήσητε τὸν Πατέρα ἐν μου τῷ ὀνόματί δῷ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: hymeis ouch exelexasthe me all’ egō exelexamēn hymas kai ethēka hymas hina hymeis hypagēte kai pherēte karpon kai ho hymōn karpos menē hina ho¦ti an aitēsēte ton Patera en mou tō onomati dō hymin
verses.literal: You {did} not choose Me but I chose you And I appointed you to - go and bear fruit - - - fruit that will remain so that whatever - you ask the Father in My - name He will give you

verses.original: ταῦτα ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: tauta entellomai hymin hina agapate allēlous
verses.literal: This is My command to you - Love one another

verses.original: Εἰ ὁ κόσμος μισεῖ ὑμᾶς γινώσκετε ὅτι μεμίσηκεν ἐμὲ πρῶτον ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ei ho kosmos misei hymas ginōskete hoti memisēken eme prōton hymōn
verses.literal: If the world hates you understand that it hated Me [first] . . .

verses.original: εἰ ἦτε ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ὁ κόσμος ἂν ἐφίλει τὸ ἴδιον δὲ τοῦτο ὁ κόσμος μισεῖ ὑμᾶς ὅτι διὰ ἐστέ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: ei ēte ek tou kosmou ho kosmos an ephilei to idion de touto ho kosmos misei hymas hoti dia este ouk ek tou kosmou all’ egō exelexamēn hymas ek tou kosmou
verses.literal: If you were of the world - [it] vvv would love [you] [as] its own Instead - the world hates you because . . . you are not of the world but I have chosen you out of the world

verses.original: Μνημονεύετε τοῦ λόγου οὗ ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν Οὐκ δοῦλος ἔστιν μείζων τοῦ αὐτοῦ κυρίου εἰ ἐδίωξαν ἐμὲ διώξουσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ εἰ ἐτήρησαν μου τὸν λόγον τηρήσουσιν τὸν ὑμέτερον καὶ
verses.transliteration: Mnēmoneuete tou logou hou egō eipon hymin Ouk doulos estin meizōn tou autou kyriou ei ediōxan eme diōxousin hymas kai ei etērēsan mou ton logon tērēsousin ton hymeteron kai
verses.literal: Remember the word that I spoke to you No servant is greater than - his master If they persecuted Me they will persecute you as well if they kept My - word they will keep - yours as well

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ποιήσουσιν πάντα εἰς ὑμᾶς ταῦτα διὰ μου τὸ ὄνομά ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασιν τὸν πέμψαντά με
verses.transliteration: alla poiēsousin panta eis hymas tauta dia mou to onoma hoti ouk oidasin ton pempsanta me
verses.literal: But they will treat . . . - you like this because of My - name since vvv they do not know the [One who] sent Me

verses.original: εἰ μὴ ἦλθον καὶ ἐλάλησα αὐτοῖς οὐκ εἴχοσαν ἁμαρτίαν νῦν δὲ ἔχουσιν οὐκ πρόφασιν περὶ αὐτῶν τῆς ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: ei mē ēlthon kai elalēsa autois ouk eichosan hamartian nyn de echousin ouk prophasin peri autōn tēs hamartias
verses.literal: If vvv I had not come and spoken to them vvv they would not be guilty of sin . . . Now however they have no excuse for their - sin

verses.original: Ὁ μισῶν ἐμὲ μισεῖ μου τὸν Πατέρα καὶ
verses.transliteration: Ho misōn eme misei mou ton Patera kai
verses.literal: Whoever hates Me hates My - Father as well

verses.original: εἰ μὴ ἐποίησα ἐν αὐτοῖς τὰ ἔργα ἃ οὐδεὶς ἄλλος ἐποίησεν οὐκ εἴχοσαν ἁμαρτίαν δὲ νῦν καὶ ἑωράκασιν καὶ μεμισήκασιν καὶ ἐμὲ καὶ μου τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: ei mē epoiēsa en autois ta erga ha oudeis allos epoiēsen ouk eichosan hamartian de nyn kai heōrakasin kai memisēkasin kai eme kai mou ton Patera
verses.literal: If vvv I had not done among them the works that no one else did vvv they would not be guilty of sin . . . but now - they have seen and hated both Me and My - Father

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἵνα πληρωθῇ ὁ λόγος ὁ γεγραμμένος ἐν αὐτῶν τῷ νόμῳ ὅτι Ἐμίσησάν με δωρεάν
verses.transliteration: all’ hina plērōthē ho logos ho gegrammenos en autōn tō nomō hoti Emisēsan me dōrean
verses.literal: But [this is] to fulfill - [what] - is written in their - Law - They hated Me without reason

verses.original: Ὅταν ὁ Παράκλητος ἔλθῃ ὃν ἐγὼ πέμψω ὑμῖν παρὰ τοῦ Πατρός τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας ὃ ἐκπορεύεται παρὰ τοῦ Πατρὸς ἐκεῖνος μαρτυρήσει περὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hotan ho Paraklētos elthē hon egō pempsō hymin para tou Patros to Pneuma tēs alētheias ho ekporeuetai para tou Patros ekeinos martyrēsei peri emou
verses.literal: When the Advocate comes whom I will send to you from the Father the Spirit - of truth who proceeds from the Father He will testify about Me

verses.original: δὲ ὑμεῖς καὶ μαρτυρεῖτε ὅτι ἐστε μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς
verses.transliteration: de hymeis kai martyreite hoti este met’ emou ap’ archēs
verses.literal: And you also must testify because you have been with Me from [the] beginning
